proposals: DGCI&S should publish an annual table of imports and exports for the EV-specific lines inside Chapter 85 — motors under HS 8501, batteries under HS 8507, and inverters and converters, so that the EV share of the roughly $50.9 billion Chapter 85 deficit is measured rather than inferred.

The Ministry of Heavy Industries should publish the domestic value addition achieved under FAME II’s Phased Manufacturing Programme for each component — motor, controller, onboard charger, DC-DC converter and wiring harness, so that localisation is reported component by component.

The Ministry of Heavy Industries should report Advanced Chemistry Cell capacity commissioned under PLI each year alongside imported cell volumes, so that progress on the single largest import item inside a battery pack can be checked.

The Finance Ministry should publish import volumes and duty collected for electric motors and power electronics since the 15% Basic Customs Duty took effect in April 2021, so that it is visible whether the duty is shifting supply to domestic makers or simply raising EV costs.
